children: BlackBerry reported second quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue rising 26% year-over-year to $163.3 million and adjusted EBITDA increasing 81% to $47.0 million. GAAP operating income improved to $33.6 million and GAAP net income was $33.9 million, the sixth consecutive quarter of positive GAAP net income. Management raised FY2027 revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook after strong first-half execution.
Total company revenue: $163.3 million, up 26% year-over-year.
Gross profit: $127.1 million; GAAP gross margin 77.8% (adjusted gross margin 78.2%).
GAAP operating income: $33.6 million (up 192% year-over-year); adjusted EBITDA: $47.0 million (up 81% year-over-year).
GAAP net income: $33.9 million; adjusted net income: $43.2 million; adjusted basic EPS: $0.07 (GAAP basic EPS $0.06).
Operating cash flow for the quarter: $29.3 million; cash and investments at quarter end: $447.1 million.
QNX delivered record quarterly revenue of $80.3 million, growing 27% year-over-year, and expanded segment adjusted gross margin to 87%.
QNX secured its first Alloy Kore design win (Coretura joint venture), noted as the largest design win in QNX history and adding over $100 million to the QNX royalty backlog.
QNX expanded Physical AI support, including SDP 8.0 partnerships and added Hailo-8 AI Accelerator support to broaden its ecosystem and performance capabilities.
Secure Communications remained a stable contributor with revenue of $60.9 million and annual recurring revenue of $221 million; DBNRR was 91%.

Product and certification milestones: SecuSUITE renewed NIAP Common Criteria certification; AtHoc added Microsoft Teams and Entra ID integrations; QNX selected by Momenta and XHEART for ISO 26262 ASIL D-certified platforms.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: BlackBerry: Q2 FY2027 revenue up 26% to $163.3M; adjusted EBITDA $47M, adjusted EPS $0.07
